powerGrid.note: Every archived copy of Marvel's page (2012 to 2018) shows only the blank default grid, all six bars at minimum width, so Marvel never recorded a rating. Not estimated.

powerOrigins.detail: No superpowers in the comics: a celebrated Soviet test pilot whom the KGB trained in combat and spycraft to be its answer to Captain America.
Fights with gear rather than powers: a returning magnetic belt disc and, in recent years, the Red Guardian shield.

abilities.name: Martial arts
abilities.detail: A superb, agile athlete schooled by the KGB in many forms of unarmed combat and martial arts.

abilities.name: Ace pilot
abilities.detail: One of the Soviet Union's most acclaimed test pilots, trusted with its most secret and dangerous flights and rated the best in his field.

abilities.name: Espionage
abilities.detail: Trained by the KGB as a covert operative after the state erased his old identity.

abilities.name: Magnetic throwing disc
abilities.detail: Hurls a disc from his belt; magnets inside the disc and belt pull it back to him.

abilities.name: Red Guardian shield
abilities.detail: Wielded the Red Guardian shield when he joined Bucky Barnes's Thunderbolts on their raid against the Red Skull.

feats.text: At a secret base in China, fought Captain America hand to hand, eager to prove the Soviet champion his better.
Already shot and dying, used his last strength to knock Colonel Ling's laser aside and save an unconscious Captain America.
Took out the defences of the Red Skull's hidden base in Latveria on his own before he was knocked out.
Won arm-wrestling bouts in a Russian prison, breaking the wrist of the hulking inmate Ursa Major.
